notes.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Sins of the Floating City — Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/7bf0f72feda243af1df42f81d5973459d413e37b.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]The fourth major expansion for Heads Will Roll: Reforged has been released![/h1][/b]
[previewyoutube=I0jVrLytCLA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/

[h2]What awaits you in the DLC:[/h2]
- No step too far, no measure too desperate:
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

- A descent into darkness:
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

- More than a dozen new characters:
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

- Europe-spanning adventure:
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

- 2 new romantic interests:
Each with their own unique story and character.

[h1]Special Offer.[/h1]
To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off
If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/687800/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Happily_Ever_After/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Not_a_Hero/

notes.title: NO MERCY RETRO FPS — Meet HMUR!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/db35c03d0fda7640f3f2aeb39b155175281e3729.jpg[/img]
Greetings to all old-school shooter fans!

Let us introduce HMUR — a fast-paced retro FPS that throws you into a twisted, alternative version of the Soviet Union in the 1990s. Combining the insane mechanics of 90s shooters, Soviet sci-fi aesthetics, and a pounding hardbass soundtrack, the game becomes a relentless dance of speed, precision, and madness.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/"][/dynamiclink]
You are Sergey, an ordinary worker. Something went terribly wrong, and now your only chance to survive is to be faster than death. [p][/p][p]Be sure to watch the trailer: 
[previewyoutube=zVDyBBJkbxk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE NOW OPEN![/h2]
Want to be among the first to push HMUR to its limits? Sign up for the playtests right now on the game’s Steam page.  
When the playtests begin, you’ll receive a notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/c230685cb4e8eca1cb8c821061c7c2fb03d15bc4.jpg[/img]

WHAT AWAITS PLAYTEST PARTICIPANTS:
[list]
[*] One life and endless restarts — in the spirit of Hotline Miami.
[*] Maximum mobility: dodge, jump, flank your enemies.
[*] Non-linear levels — choose your path and adapt your strategy on the fly.
[*] Huge arsenal — shotguns, assault rifles, heavy weapons. But ammo is worth its weight in gold.
[*] Original soundtrack — techno, hardbass, and breakcore merging with the firefight into a single rhythm.
[*] The atmosphere of a secret Soviet facility in the grip of disaster.
[/list]

[h2]🏆 EXCLUSIVE REWARD:[/h2]
Complete the playtest build — and earn an achievement. Upon release, it will turn into a golden pistol skin. This is not just a weapon, but a symbol that you survived where others gave up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/d722637b181d78f5ca45fba4570339a82a764422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/76bdbfb56a930ee05fad6db4fb7d286628267475.jpg[/img]

[h3]HMUR is created by a solo developer.[/h3]
By participating in the playtests, each of you becomes part of the game’s development story. Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TbvXbvzZTZ]Discord[/url] and become part of the community.

notes.title: Blades For Hire — Demo Out Now! Build your guild, take on contracts, and survive
notes.notes:
[h1]Forget about saving the world — you're not a hero, you're a contractor. Build your guild, take on contracts, and survive[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266666/9e055eab193f80b2a45170f3d77610e1efb44d93.jpg[/img]

Greetings, mercenaries!

We’re excited to announce that the [b]free demo[/b] of our dark tactical RPG Blades for Hire is available now on Steam — a game where loyalty has a price, and that price is gold.

And starting tomorrow, Blades for Hire will join the [b]Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition[/b] festival — stay tuned for updates, livestreams, and exclusive content on our Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180010/Blades_For_Hire_Demo/

[b]Blades for Hire[/b] is a tactical RPG that doesn’t care about your morals.
In a world no longer worth saving, you command a guild of mercenaries just trying to make a profit from what’s left. And today, you get a first look — [b]the free demo is available to everyone[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266666/123fc01fd2d19daae631a969f441eba287c7b5b9.gif[/img]

[h3][b]You're not the hero. You're the boss.[/b][/h3]
You don’t play a chosen one. You manage a struggling mercenary guild in a rotting fantasy world. Your crew? A mix of renegades, idealists, thieves, and cynics who follow you not out of loyalty — but because you pay them. On time. Or else.

[h3][b]No grand quest. Just dirty work.[/b][/h3]
There’s no prophecy or world-saving arc. Instead, you’ll face contracts filled with extortion, blackmail, massacres, and ruthless decisions. Your actions shape your reputation and unlock (or block) new opportunities. The Church may despise you — but the criminal underworld might welcome you with open arms.

[h3]What to expect in the demo:[/h3]
• First missions and early in-game choices
• Tactical combat with indirect control
• Guild economy and basic management
• A glimpse into the world and its brutal rules

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266666/a4d2894f5bb46f066adb19c2587780ed5c2a3c7f.png[/img]

[h3]What to expect in the full version:[/h3]
— [b]150+ contracts and missions:[/b]
From escorts and ambushes to betrayal, extortion, and moral gray areas.
— [b]Tactical combat with indirect control:[/b]
Set strategies and priorities — your mercs act on their own (and not always how you’d like).
— [b]Deep mercenary relationship system:[/b]
Every character is unique, with values, limits, and personalities. Bonds impact efficiency, loyalty, and story outcomes.
— [b]Guild economy system:[/b]
Salaries, equipment, hiring and firing, bribes, donations — everything has a cost.
— [b]Choices that shape the world and your reputation:[/b]
Your actions affect which factions you can work with — the Church, criminals, nobles, or outcasts. Your path determines your contracts.
— [b]No good or evil. Just consequences:[/b]
This is not a game of “right” decisions — it's about what's necessary, what's profitable, or just the least awful option.
— [b]High replayability:[/b]
Every run is different thanks to branching paths, dynamic events, and your crew’s unpredictable nature.

[h2]Wishlist, follow, and remember — there are no heroes here. Just contracts, cold steel, and the price you’re willing to pay.[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180000/Blades_For_Hire/

[h2]Got questions?[/h2]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/REsGgmh6Fq]Discord server[/url] to ask the developers directly and share feedback with the community.

notes.title: Caribbean Legend Patch 1.3 and Black Mark DLC!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/4a1a3a9e5a169d8bc75bce7cc840d9c3d88e5ba7.jpg[/img]
[h2]Ahoy![/h2]
The perfect moment to start playing Caribbean Legend!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230980/Caribbean_Legend/

[h3]First, the important stuff:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Patch 1.3 is available. We've never done anything like this before as a studio.
[*] Starting NG is not required. We recommend loading version 1.2.1 saves made while on land.
[*] Today marks the game's second 'release'—Steam will be actively promoting it for two weeks.
[*] To celebrate, we've set a historic low price—50% off.
[*] Now's the perfect moment to start playing if you’ve been holding off for any reason.
[*] Black Mark DLC is out now.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162620/Caribbean_Legend/

[h2]What's New:[/h2]
[h3]Ships[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/307e7522e668ce62f89348885e84606da24a1de1.jpg[/img]
One of the goals of Patch 1.3 was not only to rework the remaining player-favorite early-game ships but also to lay the groundwork for the planned boarding scenes. The ships turned out great.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/f9a4a0cea4b46e9f2b2a8c0803905c7c7730d88e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/bb92a57554e44b12040ec97b23b705dd42f743b5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/904dea0020e94ef30c83e5f96fd03e89ff0ad0c5.jpg[/img]

[b]New ships:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Valkyrie
[*] The Meifeng
[*] Fluyt
[*] War Schooner
[*] The Principio (DLC)
[*] Improved sail and rigging quality for all ships in the game.
[/list]
[b]In total, ~30% of the entire game fleet has been revamped by 1.3 - just as planned.

[/b]
[h3]Quests[/h3]
[b]Extinguished Star[/b]  
We’ve never created a quest this complex, non-linear, and intricate before. It has everything: new content with Mary and Helen, direct impact on the main storyline, cutscenes, crazy flashbacks, and valuable loot. The quest starts at the end of "The Dutch Gambit" and continues through to "Turtle Soup." No spoilers—see it for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/a472df15e0ab759ef50f801b5a45c4d4a545d29f.jpg[/img]
[b]Black Mark[/b]  
A non-linear quest, designed for the early stages of the game, offering valuable rewards and nods to veterans of the "Sea Dogs" series. Available in both Story and Sandbox modes. Part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162620/Caribbean_Legend/]"Black Mark" DLC[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/796fd6ecd8b2b719e464bd73408bc40d34bb7a73.jpg[/img]

Rewards include: a duelling double-barreled pistol, an Italian rapier, an Army broadsword, a Black Spot ward, armor, as well as a new officer—Tommy Irons, and the legendary Pink of Nicholas Sharp, the Principio. The Pink is stunning, but the true star of the DLC is Irons. He's got killer jokes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/d545d1771d658c07e40bc27ef4d1199bd431430d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Locations[/h3]
No new locations in this patch, aside from a few scenes for the Longway quest. The boarding decks took up almost all of our time and will continue to do so. All four decks will be included in either Patch 1.3.1 or 1.5.

However, we did update several old locations, especially those that significantly lagged behind the newer ones in quality.

[b]Locations update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Locations and scenes for the "Extinguished Star" quest
[*] The Old Lighthouse
[*] Port Royal Lighthouse
[*] Several beaches
[*] Indian village
[*] Improved ground textures in towns.
[/list]
[h3]Animations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/36b1932a71befa4a87eb7439eedaca35da3942c4.jpg[/img]

We continue the challenging journey of bringing quests, battles, and cities life to life. The minimum program has already been fulfilled, and with Patch 1.5, we aim for something even more ambitious. Next-gen is just around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/e4bdffc817a9eb257c9536c1644f9a512ff418fc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/32b3abee4fefa81358db7f09516da43afe7b9ac2.jpg[/img]

[b]New animations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Unique animations for the "Extinguished Star" quest
[*] 7 new contextual death battle animations
[*] 2 prayer animations in churches
[*] 2 animations for drunks in towns
[*] Tavern musicians no longer drown out the game’s music
[*] Fishermen, blacksmiths, and musicians now work according to the time of day
[/list]
[h3]New Hero[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/a375d3c2abd77a20c37084c2a8bc49aa3722312d.jpg[/img]
Due to popular demand, Helen McArthur is now a fully-fledged character in Sandbox mode. She is compatible with the "Vile Little God" and "Black Mark" DLCs. She has unique dialogues in her hometown Blueweld, unique achievements, loot, and starts her pirate career on a war schooner.

For now, she doesn’t carry a musket or visible armor, and there may be some "gender errors" :rofl_pirate: in the dialogues. Her development will continue in Patch 1.5, along with other Sandbox characters.

[h3]Notification System[/h3]
Traditionally, games in this series have never been known for being player-friendly or transparent, often requiring guides. What happened to my character? Why did I fail a dialogue check? What reward did I just receive? Any game needs to communicate with the player—and now Caribbean Legend does. [b]I consider this the key feature of Patch 1.3.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/c13339c8118c46e9dc4c5857f4806724ec1d7a87.jpg[/img]
[b]New notifications:[/b]
[list]
[*] Over 100 new format notifications on sea, land, and in dialogues
[*] Combat statuses—from poisonings to critical damage
[*] Loot markers—so far, only for plants in the jungle, but this is just the start
[*] Quest navigation—so far, only for the beginning of the game
[*] More quest markers over characters and on the global map
[*] New tutorial videos for core game mechanics
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/94b2f240c1ea990df3ecd70c7b5d4445dcb450c1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Interface[/h3]
Let’s be honest, we have the best interface. But somehow, the list of fixes for it has already stretched to three pages. :rofl_pirate: The first half of the first page finally made it into Patch 1.3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/03c9e371fad5d3f361d9cb22e92d78fd4914f051.jpg[/img]
[b]UI update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlimited key remapping—adjust the controls to your liking
[*] Control hints in loot, trade, and exchange windows
[*] Highlighting new entries in the ship’s log and documents
[*] Highlighting available skill points for characters
[*] Keeping the selected character when switching tabs between inventory and skills
[*] Displaying character roles in officer assignment windows
[*] Improved interaction with items in the inventory
[*] Added a DLC button in the menu—if all are purchased, it will be inactive
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/9ff765df6a71eb6a95e65d2b94ca236c3265bc56.jpg[/img]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] 13 achievements
[*] New ward
[*] New sword
[*] Automatic crash reports sending - let's see how bad it really is out there
[*] Longway can now carry muskets
[*] New dialogue camera
[*] Missing textures restored for some objects in the "Flying the Jolly Roger" quests
[*] Claude Durand now reliably triggers his loyalty event after a set time
[*] Obtaining a patent removes pirates from the crew
[*] Reputation no longer drops if the player exits "Flying the Jolly Roger" questline before Cartagena
[*] Fewer soldiers in towns, and they stop the player less often
[*] Chance to deceive the guards can no longer exceed 90%
[*] Governors no longer ask you to infiltrate friendly towns
[*] Passengers no longer ask to be taken to hostile towns
[*] "Iron Will" perk no longer allows intimidating officers
[*] Missing item descriptions—skill bonuses, etc.—have been added
[*] Additional optimization of the tutorial on Martinique
[*] Spelling and grammar corrections - thanks to all reports you have been sharing on Discord
[*] Numerous bug fixes
[*] Improved overall game stability
[/list]
[h2]1.5[/h2]
That’s all for now! Over the past six months, we’ve done an incredible amount of work together. We’ve done everything possible and even more. Except for the Story mode epilogue, of course.

We could have done it already, but it would have been too... simple? I want to create something special and worthy of Charles de Maure's story—call it a "director’s cut" of his storyline, if you will. Plus, the game has long needed list of truly new mechanics, fixes for old ones, a complete rebalance, a new loot category, and a proper uplift of Sandbox mode. Not to mention improved controls, gamepad support, Steam Deck experience.

Patch 1.5 will take at least six months, and it will definitely require starting the new game. So for now, we’ll take a short break, rest, and then get back to work.

[b]Leave reviews ːsteamthumbsupː as blue as the Caribbean Sea, download the patch, buy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162620/Caribbean_Legend/]the DLC[/url]—and if you’ve been putting off playing the game for any reason, now’s the perfect moment to start![/b]

notes.title: Stones Keeper II: The Chaos Lord announcement.
notes.notes:
Friends!

It is with great excitement that we announce the continuation of our fantasy turn-based strategy game, [b]Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord[/b]. The sequel offers both the well-known game mechanics from the original game and a variety of new features.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2779310/Stones_Keeper_II_Chaos_Lord/

Take a look at the trailer to find out more about the new chapter of the story before we dig into the details.

[previewyoutube=6tftU8wbwZI;full][/previewyoutube]

You probably still have questions. Below we will do our best to shed some light on to all the new features and explain them in detail.

[b]Who is the Chaos Lord?[/b]

Firstly, we want to point out that chaos is not something you have to fight, you are its very essence. Thus the Lord of Chaos is the main character, for whom you will have to lead the army of the undead. Nevertheless, not everything is so obvious, no one forbids you to do good deeds, playing the role of the real evil....

We would like to limit the amount of plot details to avoid spoilers, so that's all we can reveal at this time.

List of the most significant updates

[list]
[*] New campaign for the undead on behalf of Lord Chaos.
[*] ANIMATION OF ALL UNITS.
[*] Animation of air units (castles and pirate ships) on the global map
[*] Animation of all dialog portraits.
[*] Animation of castle scenes (store scene) and merchant scenes.
[*] Menu animation
[*] New race: Forest Spirits (with the ability to play as them in free-to-play mode).
[*] New story characters (heroes)
[*] Split characters into classes (warrior, assassin, support unit, rider, big guy).
[*] ZONE OF CONTROL
[*] UPDATED TRAINING SYSTEM (6 levels instead of 3. 3 new talent branches depending on the unit class).
[*] SPIN ATTACK (with effects on evasion and damage).
[*] NEW EQUIPMENT items (over 100 equipment items divided into three levels, unique items for each of the major factions, as well as items that affect the ability parameters of individual units or have an additional effect when used on the battlefield).
[*] Redesigned controls
[/list]

It is not a complete list, but it does cover all the major improvements.

Animations play a significant role in this list, as you can see. There have already been a few animations shown, and we're ready to present more.

notes.title: King Aurelius NEXT Update incoming!
notes.notes:
Namaste, Rangers!

Today we are here with some more additions for King Aurelius. Even though developers' efforts are mostly focused on balancing and polishing the Stones Keeper main game, as well as bringing in more original content, we feel that Old King deserves some love as well. 🙂

Therefore we present you with the NEXT Update!

Content

- Portugese(PTBR) localization added

General

- Buffs and debuffs have been added to the character description window. There is a new tab there now. The mini-icons will remain for now, until we receive more feedback from players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41931912/66fc476f0ff220ca8629c540b5be7602f2f1073e.jpg[/img]

- Unit evasion chance now being calculated differently. The dodge chance is now calculated randomly, without taking previous values into account. Purely based on the character's dodge parameter,
- The info icon above characters has been removed, to prevent misclicks. Now you can open the information window by clicking the right mouse button while hovering over the character model.
- The Blood Bond ability of the vampire has been fixed. The visual effect will now indicate which target was affected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41931912/ae4d7310ed69bf84350c082039c8d7770be925c8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: STONES KEEPER - Devlog
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41931912/8a30ea8cf3169d5e00ce1220818329891d8ab907.png[/img]
[i]Although the economic system of our project isn't the central mechanic of the game, it's still worth discussing. In addition, it will provide answers to why the castles fly and give some insight into other peculiar mechanics of the game.[/i]

Gold, wood, and stone are the main resources, but we won't talk about them here. Elemental stones (water, fire, earth, air) are the hot topic of our discussion today. They are easily the most valuable resources that will enable you to get additional opportunities. These items can be found either by fighting elementals or by carefully exploring the map, investigating the ruins, or looting chests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41089688/0dd4c14d1325a14688b7625e2a16b20c785e93f4.png[/img]

For instance, in order to allow your castle to travel further, you need to upgrade its movement module. And the Air Stones are the ones required to do this. You can improve your artillery power with an Earth Stone. Whether you're looking to hire an elemental guard to protect your army or if you're looking to buy unique gear and elixirs for your troops, these stones will be a big benefit to you. During the introductory part of the campaign, you will also need to gather resources to build your new castle, and for that purpose the Air Stones are essential. (A small spoiler: The King Aurelius prologue will reveal the fate of the previous fortress that belonged to the Order of the Griffin).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41089688/d414ec624d5936c64a5691132dfed0bcf4a0859d.jpg[/img]

Using the Market building, you can exchange resources and purchase elemental stones. We incorporated a dynamic resource cost system which takes into account the number of resources on the map and the number of resources exchanged by the player. In other words, by visiting the market, you will know how unique the stones that you have received are, and if it is worth using them to improve your economic situation, or if you should save them for other important improvements.
